evals.prompt: Show me the draft posts on my Ghost blog so I can see what is waiting to be finished.
evals.expected_output: Use ghost posts --status draft, which routes to the Admin API because drafts are invisible to the Content API.

evals.prompt: Create a post called Release notes on my Ghost site, then publish it once the content is reviewed.
evals.expected_output: Create with ghost create-post --title 'Release notes', then re-read it and run ghost update-post <id> --updated-at <latest> --status published.

evals.prompt: My Ghost Admin API script keeps failing with 401 INVALID_JWT even though my id:secret key looks right. What is going on?
evals.expected_output: Explain the Admin JWT contract: HS256 signature over the hex-decoded secret half, kid header set to the ID half, aud /admin/, exp at most five minutes after iat; check clock skew and that the secret is hex-decoded before signing. HS512-signed tokens are rejected with invalid algorithm.

evals.prompt: I have a Ghost Content API key. Can I use it to list my unpublished posts?
evals.expected_output: No. The Content API serves published content only and ignores non-public filters, so drafts never appear no matter how valid the key is; switch to an Admin API key with ghost posts --status draft.
assertions: states content key cannot see drafts

evals.prompt: Run ghost install to set up a new Ghost production server with nginx and ssl on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Do not route this here: ghost install belongs to Ghost's official npm ghost-cli site-management tooling, not this Ghost Admin API content skill.
assertions: routes server installs to npm ghost-cli

evals.prompt: Export every post from my Ghost site as JSON, there are several hundred.
evals.expected_output: Loop with page and limit 100 following meta.pagination.next until next is null, since limit=all is gone in Ghost 6 and pages cap at 100.
